Question: If an employee moves from GitLab Canada Corp to GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand, how does the maximum number of paid sick days they can take in a single extended absence differ between the two companies?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): In Canada the employee can receive up to 25 paid sick days, while in New Zealand the maximum is 20 days under the Holidays Act.

- **Additional Support:** Runs concurrently with [GitLab's Sick Time Policy](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#sick-time)

4. Unused sick leave is not paid out upon employment termination

Support during non-work accidents, with potential ACC coverage and GitLab top-up for extended injuries.

This will be treated as a request for reasonable accommodation and will be evaluated accordingly. Team members should follow the [process in the Handbook for requesting this leave of absence](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#for-sick-absences-that-exceed-6-consecutive-days).
